Puppet Hockey (also known as Puppet Hockey Battle) is a fast-paced, 1v1 arcade sports browser game where players control big-headed, cartoonish national hockey puppets. 
How to Play
Move: Use the Left and Right Arrow keys to skate back and forth across the rink.
Jump: Press the Up Arrow key to jump and block shots or get into position.
Shoot/Hit Puck: Press the F key (or the spacebar/onscreen icon) to swing your stick and hit the puck. 
CBC
 +2
Game Rules & Features
Match Duration: Each standard regulation match lasts 60 seconds.
Overtime: If the score is tied at the end of regulation, the match enters a 20-second overtime period.
Teams: You can select from various international national teams (such as Canada, USA, Germany, Sweden, and more) before starting a match.
Platform: It runs directly in HTML5-compatible web browsers on desktop and mobile devices without requiring any downloads.
